terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: Starter agreement template for Alambique. Adapt this with legal counsel before production use.

sections.title: Use of the service
sections.body: You may use the service according to your subscription level and internal business needs. You are responsible for how your team, contractors, and automated agents access the workspace.

sections.title: Accounts and security
sections.body: You must keep credentials secure and notify the operator of unauthorized access. You remain responsible for activity performed through your account unless the issue was caused by the operator.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: You may not use the product to break laws, abuse infrastructure, interfere with other tenants, or upload malicious code. AI automations must follow the same rules as human users.

sections.title: Changes and availability
sections.body: The product may evolve over time. Features can be improved, renamed, or removed with reasonable notice when appropriate. Availability goals should be defined in your commercial agreement, not only in this template.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Starter privacy template for Alambique. Review with legal counsel before production use.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: We may collect account details, authentication data, product usage events, and operational metadata needed to secure, maintain, and improve the service.

sections.title: Why we process data
sections.body: We process data to provide the service, authenticate users, prevent abuse, support customers, send transactional communications, and understand product reliability.

sections.title: How data is shared
sections.body: Data may be shared with subprocessors that help operate the service, such as infrastructure, email, analytics, and support tooling providers. We do not sell personal data.

sections.title: Retention and rights
sections.body: We retain data only as long as necessary for operational, contractual, or legal reasons. Depending on jurisdiction, users may request access, correction, export, or deletion of personal data.
